Name: Christmas_Weaver_Feast_Line
$Comment: Elsie's Christmas line in her Harvest Feast conversation. Christmas starts while the feast's last
days still run, and while the feast runs Elsie stands at her feast spot speaking her feast
conversation (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Weaver_Temple.json takes its feast entry first). This line
lets a player reach her Christmas stall from the first day of Christmas all the same, and its second
line opens her quest list, where her Christmas quests (Wrapping Presents, christmas_wrapping_presents,
her daily, Daily Wrapping, christmas_daily_wrapping, and her apprentice quest,
christmas_elsie_apprentice) are offered, carried and handed in, since they are bound to the id she
keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Weaver), beside the day's job from her own board
(Boards/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Weaver_Jobs.json, which Hosts that id). Once the feast is over she
speaks her Christmas conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Weaver.json), which offers the
stall and the quests itself, and the feast conversation is no longer reached.
Dialogues.Ids names her feast conversation alone, since each villager's lines open that villager's
own stall and quests. They land on the screens the conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines
and before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers them only while Christmas runs; to
take them out, set Enabled false in a file of the same name. The lines pay nothing themselves.
